- License: **MIT**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Automatic compaction condenses history when token pressure builds, and it

were one finished sub-task and the next ten are "},{"id":"p11s3","text":" has no idea that the last forty messages

still occupy the context window."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"After a block closes, the next request carries a summary in place of its
completed work. Replacing h"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"istory can also invalidate the cached suffix:

"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"messages remain. The baseline has not reached its automatic compaction threshold."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"See the data, assumptions and reproduction steps.

contribute the union of their ids.
2. `tools.block_compact({ ids, content })` rep"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"laces the complete interval from
the earliest to the latest occurrence of any target id with the ret"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"ained content.
3. The summary inherits the union of the interval's ids minus the target ids.
It can "},{"id":"p20s6","text":"participate in a later summary. A summary with no remaining ids stays.
